sources.title: GDPR Art. 22 — automated decisions
sources.why: Mandates human intervention and the right to contest automated decisions, the core legal safeguard against blindly trusting machine outputs.

sources.title: EU AI Act — transparency obligations (Art. 50)
sources.why: Requires users be told when an output is machine-generated, countering uncritical over-trust in AI by making automation visible.

sources.title: EU AI Act — high-risk AI (Annex III §1(a))
sources.why: Imposes a human-oversight regime so operators can detect and override AI recommendations rather than defer to them automatically.
